Project context → WORK/<Company>/<Project>/Branding Materials/ or References/. Generic/template → RESOURCES/RESOURCES Templates/. No project signal → _Inbox/ (design source files are too valuable to bury automatically). InDesign trio (.indd/.idml/.idlk) groups together — same destination.

Sidecars follow their parent media file by basename match (clip.mp4.pfl parents to clip.mp4; movie.srt parents to movie.mp4). Route to wherever the parent goes. Orphan sidecars (no parent in same folder) → _Inbox.

Almost always part of an atomic-unit folder (device-export backup, research dataset). Route the WHOLE folder, not individual files. If loose: research-tied → EDUCATION/EDUCATION Research/<Topic>/Data/. Medical device data → PERSONAL/PERSONAL Medical/<Person>/. Never propose per-file moves. TIE-BREAK (.edn/.f/.f90/.h): these extensions appear here only; they have been removed from Code Source. When a loose .edn/.f/.f90/.h file appears in a code/project context rather than a research/data context, use Code Source routing (atomic-unit or _Inbox), not Scientific Data — the atomic-unit parent-folder context is the authoritative tie-break.

Obsolete formats (Flash retired 2020, Director retired 2017). Inside an atomic 'Old Projects' folder → route whole folder. Loose → _Inbox/ with ? — most are unreadable on modern machines and worth reviewing for deletion.

If inside a Python venv (pyvenv.cfg present in ancestor), Unity Assets/ tree, or node_modules — route the WHOLE folder as an atomic unit. Loose code files (.py/.js/.ts/.go/etc) → _Inbox/ with ? noting 'shouldn't be in OneDrive'. EXCEPTION: .json/.xml/.yaml/.yml are data/config, not code — see references/file-type-routing.md 'Code and config' section, which is authoritative for these four extensions: if inside a project folder, route to that project's Docs/ or References/; if standalone with no context, _Inbox/ (no ? flag — ordinary data file, not a stray script). WHY these four extensions still appear in THIS entry's own 'extensions' array despite file-type-routing.md governing their final routing: this JSON's keyword/extension fallback matching (used to find candidate categories before the onedrive_hint's routing rule is applied) needs them present to recognize a .json/.xml/.yaml/.yml file as belonging to the 'Code Source' category at all — removing them here would make matching miss these files entirely, not just skip the ?-flag treatment. NOTE: .edn/.f/.f90/.h are NOT listed here — they appear in Scientific Data (atomic-folder context wins for those extensions; use Scientific Data routing when the file is loose or context is ambiguous).

Not extensions but folder-name / marker-file patterns. See SKILL.md 'Atomic-unit folders' section. Detected via: pyvenv.cfg, zotero.sqlite, .unity files, folder names matching node_modules/Backups.backupdb/etc. When detected: generate ONE proposal for the whole folder, not per-file.
